overloads.semanticRole: Writes a CDATA section (automatically framed by <![CDATA[ ... ]]>) containing text or BLOB data inside the currently open element of the SAX document referenced by document.

constraints: An XML element must already be open (via SAX OPEN XML ELEMENT) for this command to succeed; otherwise an error is generated.
To encode data's contents, pass a BLOB (encoded via BASE64 ENCODE); the data type (Blob vs Text) selects how the CDATA payload is produced.

Reference lifecycle (implied convention, not syntactically enforced): SAX XML document-write lifecycle: obtain a document reference (e.g. via Create document/OPEN DOCUMENT) -> optionally SAX SET XML DECLARATION and document-level SAX ADD XML DOCTYPE/PROCESSING INSTRUCTION/COMMENT calls -> SAX OPEN XML ELEMENT / SAX ADD XML ELEMENT VALUE / SAX ADD XML CDATA for element content (nested opens require matching SAX CLOSE XML ELEMENT) -> CLOSE DOCUMENT.
